title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Manual Testing Execution**

* Conduct comprehensive manual testing of web\-based and desktop\-based applications covering functional, integration, system, and UAT phases.
* Execute exploratory testing to identify edge cases and potential defects.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains unaffected by changes.
* Conduct user experience (UX) and usability testing to validate application usability.
* Participate in UAT coordination and sign\-off processes with stakeholders.

**2\. Automation Testing \& Framework Design**

* Design and implement robust automation frameworks according to project structure and best practices.
* Develop, design and execute automated tests using scripts and automation tools (Selenium, UFT, TestNG, etc.) to validate functionality.
* Create and maintain reusable test libraries, utilities, and components to maximize code efficiency.
* Implement data\-driven testing approaches to test multiple scenarios with varied inputs.
* Establish continuous integration (CI) pipelines for automated test execution.
* Maintain and enhance test automation suites to ensure continuous coverage of critical application paths and regression prevention.
* Document test automation architecture, design patterns, and maintenance guidelines.

**3\. Test Planning \& Case Development**

* Create and implement detailed test cases for functional, unit, performance, security, and scalability testing.
* Establish comprehensive test strategies tailored to product characteristics and client requirements.
* Define test scenarios, test data requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test executions.

**4\. Security Testing \& Vulnerability Assessment**

* Conduct comprehensive security testing to identify vulnerabilities, security flaws, and compliance gaps in applications.
* Perform SQL injection testing, cross\-site scripting (XSS) testing, cross\-site request forgery (CSRF), and authentication/authorization testing.
* Execute load and stress testing to validate application behavior under extreme conditions and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Identify and document security risks, data protection issues, potential exploits, and compliance concerns.
* Validate secure data transmission, encryption protocols, secure session management, and SSL/TLS implementations.
* Test API security, OAuth/JWT authentication mechanisms, role\-based access control (RBAC), and permission enforcement.
* Perform penetration testing and vulnerability assessment to simulate real\-world attacks.
* Coordinate with Development and Security teams to remediate identified security issues and implement secure coding practices.
* Ensure adherence to security standards and regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001, etc.) as applicable.

**5\. Defect Identification \& Quality Assurance**

* Detect and minimize bugs, errors, technical, security, and functional flaws in applications.
* Establish quantitative trends of types of bugs and their recurring frequency for continuous improvement.
* Outline steps for minimizing defects and preventing recurrence.
* Ensure thorough defect management through proactive follow\-up and feedback with Development Teams.

**6\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Prepare comprehensive Test Result Reports (TRR) for each tested release.
* Ensure immediate discussion with Technology Team for validation of observations in TRR.
* Maintain detailed testing documentation and execution logs.
* Generate meaningful reports on testing progress, defect metrics, security findings, and quality trends.

**7\. Quality Culture \& Process Adherence**

* Establish and promote culture of 'High Product Quality' and 'Zero Defect' amongst Development and Product Teams.
* Follow defined standard practices and methodologies for testing and defect tracking.
* Suggest new tools and techniques to improve test efficiency, automation coverage, and overall QA strategies.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and other applicable guidelines.

**Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / MCA or other Technical Graduates with formal course\-work in Software Development, Testing or Quality Assurance
* Certification in Software Testing or Automation Testing
* 3\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing profile for Software solutions
* In\-depth knowledge of Software Testing Process and methodologies is a pre\-requisite
* Sound understanding of Functional Testing and .Net platform (especially ASP.Net) is expected
* Hands\-on experience with both manual testing and automation testing frameworks
* Knowledge of Security Testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment, and security risk identification
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10, common web application vulnerabilities, and security best practices
* Keen desire to research and learn emerging testing techniques and ability to incorporate these meaningfully in products
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to identify root causes and structure solutions
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to engage confidently with stakeholders

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* Hands\-on experience on all types of Software Testing methodologies (Black Box, White Box, Grey Box, etc.)
* Specialization in Security and/or Automated Testing
* Hands\-on experience on Selenium/Unified Functional Testing (UFT) or similar automation tools
* Knowledge in Selenium Tools such as Selenium IDE, Selenium RC, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG \& Selenium Grid
* Knowledge of Android / iOS testing tools and mobile app testing methodologies
* Knowledge of Security testing tools and practices
* Exposure to test management tools (HP ALM, Qtest, or equivalent)
* Sound interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
